scripts.test:db:up: docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.test.yml up -d postgres minio && sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do curl --fail --silent http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1'
scripts.test:unit: sh -c 'export DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nutriflow_test TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nutriflow_test AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=minioadmin AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=minioadmin AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3=http://localhost:9000 AWS_REGION=us-east-1 S3_BUCKET=nutriflow-test S3_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:9000/nutriflow-test RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL=10000 RATE_LIMIT_AUTH=10000 RATE_LIMIT_REFRESH=10000 RATE_LIMIT_UPLOAD=10000 RATE_LIMIT_ANALYZE=10000; bun test src'
scripts.test:integration: sh -c 'export DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nutriflow_test TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nutriflow_test AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=minioadmin AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=minioadmin AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3=http://localhost:9000 AWS_REGION=us-east-1 S3_BUCKET=nutriflow-test S3_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:9000/nutriflow-test RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL=10000 RATE_LIMIT_AUTH=10000 RATE_LIMIT_REFRESH=10000 RATE_LIMIT_UPLOAD=10000 RATE_LIMIT_ANALYZE=10000; bun test $(find test/integration -name "*.spec.ts" ! -name "*.eval.spec.ts" -print)'
scripts.test:e2e: sh -c 'export DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nutriflow_test TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nutriflow_test AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=minioadmin AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=minioadmin AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3=http://localhost:9000 AWS_REGION=us-east-1 S3_BUCKET=nutriflow-test S3_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:9000/nutriflow-test RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL=10000 RATE_LIMIT_AUTH=10000 RATE_LIMIT_REFRESH=10000 RATE_LIMIT_UPLOAD=10000 RATE_LIMIT_ANALYZE=10000; bun test $(find test/e2e -name "*.spec.ts" ! -name "rate-limit.e2e.spec.ts" -print)'
scripts.test:rate-limit: sh -c 'export DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nutriflow_test TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nutriflow_test AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=minioadmin AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=minioadmin AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3=http://localhost:9000 AWS_REGION=us-east-1 S3_BUCKET=nutriflow-test S3_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:9000/nutriflow-test RATE_LIMIT_AUTH=2; bun test test/e2e/rate-limit.e2e.spec.ts'
scripts.test:rate-limit:local: bun run test:db:up && bun run test:db:migrate && bun run test:rate-limit
scripts.test:ai: sh -c 'export DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nutriflow_test TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nutriflow_test AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=minioadmin AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=minioadmin AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3=http://localhost:9000 AWS_REGION=us-east-1 S3_BUCKET=nutriflow-test S3_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:9000/nutriflow-test; bun test test/integration/food-analysis.eval.spec.ts'
scripts.test: bun run test:db:up && bun run test:db:migrate && bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration && bun run test:e2e && bun run test:rate-limit
